## Repository-wide mechanisms

### 1. Ownership rules (CODEOWNERS)

[`.github/CODEOWNERS`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.github/CODEOWNERS) defines two explicit ownership tiers:

- **`@gastownhall/gascity-admin`** owns all CI-critical paths: `.github/workflows/`, `.github/actions/`, `.githooks/`, `Makefile`, `go.mod`/`go.sum`, `Dockerfile*`, `scripts/`, `contrib/k8s/`, `internal/buildimage/`, dashboard SPA package manifests, and the rollout-flag registry `internal/rollout/registry.go` (lines 2–21). A comment on line 19–21 explicitly notes the registry is "the only human gate on flag Expires extensions and Category classification."
- **`@csells`** owns authored content subdirectories under `docs/` (lines 26–32).

### 2. Pull request template

[`.github/pull_request_template.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.github/pull_request_template.md) mandates:
- `make check` (always)
- `make check-docs` when docs/navigation/links change
- `make test-integration` when runtime, controller, or workflow behavior changes
- Checklist: linked issue, tests for behavior changes, docs for user-facing changes, breaking-change callout

### 3. Git hooks

**Pre-commit** ([`.githooks/pre-commit`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.githooks/pre-commit)):
- Formats staged `.go` files via `scripts/precommit-format-staged-go`
- Runs `make lint-changed LINT_CHANGED_SCOPE=staged` with `--fix` on staged Go files
- Auto-regenerates and stages: OpenAPI spec (`go run ./cmd/genspec` → `internal/api/openapi.json` + `docs/reference/schema/openapi.{json,txt}`), generated API client (`go run ./internal/api/genclient` → `internal/api/genclient/client_gen.go`), config/schema docs (`go run ./cmd/genschema` → `docs/reference/schema/*.{json,txt}`, `docs/reference/{config,cli}.md`)
- Runs `make vet`
- Conditionally rebuilds the dashboard SPA (`make dashboard-check dashboard-smoke`) when the OpenAPI spec or SPA source changes; guarded on npm availability
- Docs check (`make check-docs`) when `.md`/`docs/**`/etc. files are staged
- Comment at line 36 explains that heavy `go test` was deliberately moved to pre-push to avoid multi-GiB compile storms on constrained hosts (issue `#3628`)

**Pre-push** ([`.githooks/pre-push`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.githooks/pre-push)):
- Detects whether any pushed ref contains `.go` changes vs the remote
- Runs a bead ownership/staleness guard (`scripts/push-ownership-guard.sh`, `assert_bead_still_claimed`) before every non-deletion push, regardless of language changes (bypassed via `git push --no-verify`)
- Runs `make test-fast-parallel` only when Go sources changed

### 4. Linters

[`.golangci.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.golangci.yml) (golangci-lint v2):
- Severity: `error` for all issues; unlimited `max-issues-per-linter` and `max-same-issues`
- Formatters: `gofumpt`, `goimports`
- Explicit linters: `govet`, `errorlint`, `misspell` (locale US), `gocritic`, `revive`, `unconvert`, `unparam`; default linters (`errcheck`, `ineffassign`, `staticcheck`, `unused`) also remain enabled
- Named exclusions for `revive` var-naming in established packages (`internal/runtime/`, `internal/api/`, `internal/mail/`, etc.) and stutter rules in `internal/convoy/`, `internal/graphroute/`, `internal/sling/`

Actionlint is configured at [`.github/actionlint.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.github/actionlint.yaml) with the full set of self-hosted Blacksmith runner labels recognized.

### 5. CI workflow (`ci.yml`)

[`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.github/workflows/ci.yml) triggers on `push` to `main` and PR events (`opened`, `reopened`, `synchronize`, `ready_for_review`). It is also callable as a reusable workflow. Concurrency cancellation is PR-only.

| Job | Gating | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `runner-policy` | always | Python script selects Blacksmith vs ubuntu-latest based on PR author and `force_blacksmith` |
| `changes` | always | `dorny/paths-filter` produces path-gated outputs; shared paths (`go.mod`, `Makefile`, CI files, `internal/beads/**`, `internal/events/**`, `internal/config/**`) force full union run |

| `preflight-generated` | always | `make dashboard-ci`, `make spec-ci` (OpenAPI + client drift), `./scripts/check-generated-docs-drift.sh`; uploads `generated-docs-freshness.patch` artifact on failure |
| `contract-acceptance-previous` | always | Installs `BD_PREV_VERSION` (minimum-supported bd), runs `make test-bd-cli-contract` |
| `contract-acceptance-current` | beads filter | Builds bd from `BD_CURRENT_REF` source, runs `make test-bd-cli-contract` |
| `contract-radar-bd-head` | beads filter | Builds bd from beads `main` HEAD (non-required advisory lane) |
| `check` | fan-in | Branch-protection required status; `contract-acceptance-current` is the only allowed-skip |
| `cmd-gc-process` | cmd_gc_process filter | 12 parallel shards, 10 min timeout each |
| `cmd-gc-productmetrics-testhook` | cmd_gc_process filter | Required product-metrics testhook profile |
| `credential-provider-windows` | credential_provider filter | Windows Job Object descendant cleanup test |
| `integration-shards` | integration filter | 14 named shards (packages-core ×4, packages-cmd-gc-integration, packages-runtime-tmux ×6, bdstore, rest-smoke ×2) |
| `integration-rest-full` | push + integration filter | 16 shards; push-only (not run on PRs) |
| `worker-core-{claude,codex,gemini}` | worker filter | WorkerCore transcript/continuation conformance per LLM profile |
| `worker-core-summary` | always (fan-in) | Requires rollup JSON with `status: pass`; asserts all three profiles succeeded |
| `worker-core-phase2-{claude,codex,gemini}` | worker_phase2 filter | Phase-2 conformance |
| `worker-core-phase2-summary` | always (fan-in) | Same rollup assertion as phase-1 |
| `pack-gate` | packs filter | Bundled gastown pack pin check + live registry smoke (retried up to 3×) |
| `dashboard` | always | TypeScript typecheck (3 passes), Vitest, build, Playwright Chromium render smoke (Layer B) |
| `openclaw-bridge` | openclaw_bridge filter | `npm ci && npm test` in `contrib/openclaw-bridge/` |
| `mcp-mail` | mail filter | `continue-on-error: true`; MCP mail conformance |
| `docker-session` | docker filter | `make test-docker` |
| `k8s-session` | k8s filter | Runs only when `GC_K8S_AVAILABLE` secret is set |
| `ci-preflight` | fan-in | `CI / preflight` (aggregates preflight + contract gates + release-config + dashboard) |
| `ci-integration` | fan-in | `CI / integration` (aggregates integration-shards + rest-full; both are allow-skipped) |
| `ci-required` | fan-in | `CI / required` — the branch-protection status; path-gated jobs are allow-skipped; `worker-core-summary` and `worker-core-phase2-summary` are unconditional |
| `release-config` | always | `goreleaser check` |

Golangci-lint cache uses an exact-key-only strategy (no `restore-keys` fallback) to prevent cache poisoning — this is explicitly documented inline (lines 228–233) referencing incidents `ga-35qn7i`, `ga-v7x9vk`, etc.

### 6. Generated-artifact checks

[`codecov.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/codecov.yml) tracks six coverage flags (`unit`, `integration-packages`, `integration-review-formulas`, `integration-bdstore`, `integration-rest-smoke`, `integration-rest-full`) with `carryforward: true`. `internal/api/genclient/client_gen.go` is explicitly excluded from coverage with the comment "Generated from internal/api/openapi.json and verified by TestGeneratedClientInSync."

The spec/client drift check (`preflight-generated` job) enforces `GC_REQUIRE_OAPI_CODEGEN=1` so the check cannot silently skip when `oapi-codegen` is absent.

### 7. Known-flake registry

[`repo-policy.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/repo-policy.py) contains a list of `known_flake_check_prefixes`. At this revision there is one active entry:
```

```
with the comment: `root-fix: ga-jtjaiy; remove when ga-hm6t73.1 (WP-A) or ga-8yv2fi.1 (WP-B) lands on main`. This is the only evidence in the repo of a formal flake acknowledgement mechanism.

### 8. Review-formulas workflow

[`.github/workflows/review-formulas.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.github/workflows/review-formulas.yml) is a separate workflow (not part of the main CI graph). It routes via a `gate` job:
- **Pull requests without `needs-review-formulas` label** and **draft PRs**: skipped
- **PRs with `needs-review-formulas` label**: runs 5 shards (basic ×2, retries ×2, recovery)
- **Pushes to `main`** and **`workflow_dispatch`**: always runs (post-merge safety net)

Coverage uploads to Codecov with flag `integration-review-formulas` are guarded to non-fork PRs and push events.

[`.github/workflows/rc-gate.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.github/workflows/rc-gate.yml) is manually dispatched only. ### 10. Testing policy (`TESTING.md`)

[`TESTING.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/TESTING.md) is the normative testing policy. Key mechanically-enforced items:

- **Source-resource ledger** (`test/test-resources.toml`): checked anti-growth ratchets for `fixed_sleep`, `subprocess`, `net_listen`, `http_test_server`, `tmux`, `cwd`, `environment`, `listener_helper`, `net_listen_config`, `net_listen_packet`, `syscall_listen`, `slow_process_gate`. Baselines are embedded in TESTING.md (lines 447–482). Run with:
  ```bash
  go test -count=1 ./internal/testpolicy/resourcecensus -run '^TestRepositoryLedgerMatchesCensusAndDocumentation$'
  ```
- **Runtime provider ledger** (lines 1280–1300): checked by `go test ./internal/testutil/providerledger`. Lists every production runtime constructor, its proof status or waiver (with expiry dates through 2026-08-12), and which conformance test covers it.
- **Five test categories**: unit, testscript (`.txtar`), integration (`//go:build integration`), docsync (`test/docsync`), coordination — with explicit layer boundaries for what each proves
- **Flake policy**: "A deterministic product-test failure may not be retried into green on the same tested SHA" (line 229). Quarantine requires a checked ledger, tracking bead, failure evidence, nonblocking lane, and expiry.
- **Sleep prohibition**: `time.Sleep` and open-coded polling loops are forbidden in new/modified tests; minimum deadline for goroutine/exec/socket races is ≥ 10s using `testutil.GoroutineRaceTimeout` / `testutil.ExecRaceTimeout`
- **PR static-check scope**: changed-scope lint applies only when the checkout is GitHub's two-parent synthetic merge with the first parent equal to the exact base SHA; all other events (push, dispatch) use full scope

### 11. Release gates directory

[`release-gates/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/release-gates) contains ~220 Markdown gate files named by bead ID (e.g., `ga-b1jf1r-2-golangci-cache-key-gate.md`, `ga-v7x9vk-*`, `sa5011-lint-cache-poisoning-gate.md`). These are the tracked follow-up gate records for specific changes, fixes, and reverts. Notable entries include:
- `sa5011-lint-cache-poisoning-gate.md` — references the golangci-lint cache poisoning fix
- `ga-nhwmeb-fix-timing-test-flakes-gate.md` — timing flake fix gate
- `ga-q32h2b-test-deflakes-gate.md` — test deflake gate
- `ga-kw7i0z-flaky-tmux-gate.md` — tmux flake gate
- `ga-co7mdp-gc-stop-hang-fix-gate.md` — follow-up fix gate
- `ga-j4imaw-go1264-cve-2026-42504-gate.md` — CVE fix gate

To verify specific claims at this revision:

```bash
# Resource ledger matches code
go test -count=1 ./internal/testpolicy/resourcecensus \
  -run '^TestRepositoryLedgerMatchesCensusAndDocumentation$'

# Runtime provider ledger is up-to-date
go test ./internal/testutil/providerledger

# CI policy self-check (make targets, workflow scope contracts)
make test-ci-policy

# Linter runs on the full repo
make lint

# Full static suite
make check

# Docs drift
make check-docs

# OpenAPI spec and generated client are in sync
make spec-ci

# Dashboard bundle drift
make dashboard-ci

# Generated docs drift (emits patch file on failure)
./scripts/check-generated-docs-drift.sh

# go.mod replace guard
make check-gomod-replace

# Minimum-supported bd contract
make test-bd-cli-contract

# Acceptance Tier A
make test-acceptance

# Bead ownership guard (normally fired by pre-push hook)
. scripts/push-ownership-guard.sh && assert_bead_still_claimed
```

with the comment: `root-fix: ga-jtjaiy; remove when ga-hm6t73.1 (WP-A) or ga-8yv2fi.1 (WP-B) lands on main`. This is the only evidence in the repo of a formal flake acknowledgement mechanism.

### 8. Review-formulas workflow

[`.github/workflows/review-formulas.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.github/workflows/review-formulas.yml) is a separate workflow (not part of the main CI graph). It routes via a `gate` job:
- **Pull requests without `needs-review-formulas` label** and **draft PRs**: skipped
- **PRs with `needs-review-formulas` label**: runs 5 shards (basic ×2, retries ×2, recovery)
- **Pushes to `main`** and **`workflow_dispatch`**: always runs (post-merge safety net)

Coverage uploads to Codecov with flag `integration-review-formulas` are guarded to non-fork PRs and push events.

### 9. RC gate (`rc-gate.yml`)

[`.github/workflows/rc-gate.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/.github/workflows/rc-gate.yml) is manually dispatched only. It reuses the shared `ci.yml` (`ci_parity`) and adds RC-specific jobs: fast unit tests (6 cmd/gc shards + unit-core + darwin compile), acceptance tiers A/B/C (A and C require Ollama), full integration shards (30+), tutorial goldens (6 shards, 90 min timeout), goreleaser snapshot with release binary metadata verification, and Mac regression. The `rc_summary` job fails if any dependency is not `success` or `skipped`. `GC_TEST_NO_SLICE=1` is set globally because Blacksmith runners cannot reliably create systemd transient scopes.

### 10. Testing policy (`TESTING.md`)

[`TESTING.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/TESTING.md) is the normative testing policy. Key mechanically-enforced items:

- **Source-resource ledger** (`test/test-resources.toml`): checked anti-growth ratchets for `fixed_sleep`, `subprocess`, `net_listen`, `http_test_server`, `tmux`, `cwd`, `environment`, `listener_helper`, `net_listen_config`, `net_listen_packet`, `syscall_listen`, `slow_process_gate`. Baselines are embedded in TESTING.md (lines 447–482). Run with:
  ```bash
  go test -count=1 ./internal/testpolicy/resourcecensus -run '^TestRepositoryLedgerMatchesCensusAndDocumentation$'
  ```
- **Runtime provider ledger** (lines 1280–1300): checked by `go test ./internal/testutil/providerledger`. Lists every production runtime constructor, its proof status or waiver (with expiry dates through 2026-08-12), and which conformance test covers it.
- **Five test categories**: unit, testscript (`.txtar`), integration (`//go:build integration`), docsync (`test/docsync`), coordination — with explicit layer boundaries for what each proves
- **Flake policy**: "A deterministic product-test failure may not be retried into green on the same tested SHA" (line 229). Quarantine requires a checked ledger, tracking bead, failure evidence, nonblocking lane, and expiry.
- **Sleep prohibition**: `time.Sleep` and open-coded polling loops are forbidden in new/modified tests; minimum deadline for goroutine/exec/socket races is ≥ 10s using `testutil.GoroutineRaceTimeout` / `testutil.ExecRaceTimeout`
- **PR static-check scope**: changed-scope lint applies only when the checkout is GitHub's two-parent synthetic merge with the first parent equal to the exact base SHA; all other events (push, dispatch) use full scope
